lines.en: label toukaspecial15:
scene sky
I begin my voyage to...wherever the wind takes me bright and early.
lines.zh: 我一大清早就启程前往……风把我带到哪儿算哪儿的地方。

lines.en: In fact, it’s so early that the wind hasn’t even woken up yet, so I’m kind of just going in a straight line and not being {i}taken{/i} anywhere.
lines.zh: 其实太早了，连风都还没醒，所以我基本是在走直线、哪儿也没被{i}带去{/i}。

lines.en: I guess that’s fine, though, considering that the area I normally meet up with Touka in is a {i}mostly{/i} straight shot from my home.
lines.zh: 不过也没关系——反正我平常跟 Touka 碰头的地方，从我家{i}几乎{/i}是一条直线。

lines.en: I {i}also{/i} guess that since I just mentioned Touka, there’s a high likelihood that I’ll bump into her and take her on the makeshift commoner’s tour of summer that she wants.
lines.zh: {i}而且{/i}我猜，既然我刚提到 Touka，那我就很有可能撞上她，带她体验她想要的那场「临时平民夏日游」。

lines.en: It’s a good thing I’ve spent so long looking up and preparing different activities I think she’ll thoroughly enjoy.
lines.zh: 好在我花了大把时间查资料、准备了一堆我觉得她会特别喜欢的活动。

lines.en: That was sarcasm if you couldn’t tell.
lines.zh: 听不出来的话，那是反话。

lines.en: I have absolutely no idea what the two of us are going to do today when we inevitably meet.
lines.zh: 我完全不知道等会儿真碰面了，我俩今天要干嘛。

lines.en: But at least we’ll get to be alone.
lines.zh: 但至少我们能独处。

lines.en: : Oh. Good morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦。早上好，Sensei。

lines.en: scene toukatrain1
Or not.
lines.zh: 或者独处不了。

lines.en: : Good morning, entire Tsukioka family.
lines.zh: : 早上好，月冈全家。

lines.en: : Well, it’s...not the {i}entire{/i} family without my father.
lines.zh: : 呃……没有我父亲，就还算不上{i}「全家」{/i}。

lines.en: : Yeah, but he doesn’t really matter to me.
lines.zh: : 是，可他对我来说无所谓。

lines.en: : Good morning, commoner teacher man! We are ready to walk among you and your people! We come in peace!
lines.zh: : 早上好，平民老师先生！我们准备好走进你们和你们的人群了！我们为和平而来！

lines.en: : Good morning, mini Touka. I like your shirt and I’m sure there won’t be anyone around today who is offended by it.
lines.zh: : 早上好，小 Touka。我喜欢你这件 T 恤，而且我相信今天不会有任何人被它冒犯到。

lines.en: scene toukatrain2
: I tried very hard to get her to wear something else, but she was insistent on trying to look like “As much of a commoner as possible.”
lines.zh: : 我费了好大劲想让她换件别的，可她坚持要打扮得「尽量像个平民」。

lines.en: : Of course I was! Talking to Chinami has made me realize how important it is to make time for those smaller and less significant than me!
lines.zh: : 我当然要！跟 Chinami 聊过之后，我明白了为那些比我小、比我「不重要」的人腾出时间有多重要！

lines.en: : I understand that, but...I don’t really think your shirt will accomplish that, dear.
lines.zh: : 我懂，可是……我不太觉得你这件 T 恤能达成那个目的，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Honestly, though, if “looking normal” is what you were all going for, Tsukasa is, weirdly enough, the closest out of everyone.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，如果你们的目标都是「看着普通」，那 Tsukasa 居然是最接近的一个，怪了。

lines.en: scene toukatrain3
: With a shirt as...{i}direct{/i} as that? How is that possible?
lines.zh: : 穿那么……{i}直白{/i}的 T 恤？怎么可能？

lines.en: : I don’t know. You two just sort of...exude wealth. Tsukasa just looks like a weird kid.
lines.zh: : 不知道。你们俩就是浑身……透着有钱。Tsukasa 只是看着像个怪小孩。

lines.en: scene toukatrain4
: Wha- weird?! Who do you think you are belittling, peasant?! I am Tsukasa Tsukioka! I am royalty! I am-
lines.zh: : 什——怪？！你以为你在贬低谁，平民？！我可是 Tsukasa Tsukioka！我是皇族！我是——

lines.en: : A weird kid.
lines.zh: : 一个怪小孩。

lines.en: scene toukatrain5
: You told me he was nice.
lines.zh: : 你跟我说他人很好的。

lines.en: : Is “nice” the word I used? Because I specifically recall using the word “fine” to describe him in place of that.
lines.zh: : 我用的是「好」这个词吗？因为我分明记得我用的是「还行」来形容他。

lines.en: : That’s a lot closer, but still a bit off.
lines.zh: : 那倒更接近了，不过还是不太准。

lines.en: : I hope you don’t mind that Tsukasa and I decided to tag along for your summer tour today. She just wouldn’t take no for an answer when she heard about it and...
lines.zh: : 希望你不介意 Tsukasa 和我决定跟来你今天的「夏日游」。她一听说就怎么也不肯罢休，而且……

lines.en: : Well, let’s just say it’s been quite a while since I’ve really ventured off for the sole purpose of leisure as well.
lines.zh: : 这么说吧，我也已经很久没有纯粹为了消遣而出远门了。

lines.en: : It’s fine, but I still think you guys are making a much bigger deal out of this than it really is.
lines.zh: : 没事。不过我还是觉得你们把这事看得太重了。

lines.en: : Like, I still have no idea what to even do today.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我到现在都还不知道今天要干嘛。

lines.en: : I tried telling you before, but I’m not really the best person to ask about “fun” stuff like this.
lines.zh: : 我之前就跟你说过，关于「好玩」的事，我真不是最合适的请教对象。

lines.en: scene toukatrain6
: You don’t have {i}any{/i} ideas? At all?
lines.zh: : 你{i}一个{/i}主意都没有？完全没有？

lines.en: : I mean, you’ve already been to the beach. That about sums up my knowledge of summer.
lines.zh: : 我是说，你们已经去过海边了。我对夏天的认知差不多就这么多。

lines.en: : I guess there are public pools too, but those are somehow even less fun and probably underwhelming for people of your...status.
lines.zh: : 大概还有公共泳池，不过那些更没意思，而且对你们这种……身份的人来说，多半不够格。

lines.en: : Our “status” is precisely what we are attempting to leave behind today, Sensei. Why else would we have dressed so casually?
lines.zh: : 我们今天要抛下的恰恰就是「身份」，Sensei。不然我们干嘛穿得这么随意？

lines.en: : Sorry, is that dress supposed to be casual? Because it really just looks like you’re trying to impress someone.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，那条裙子算「随意」？因为它看着明明像你要刻意惊艳谁。

lines.en: scene toukatrain7
: How funny. That’s exactly what I told her before we left the manor this morning.
lines.zh: : 真巧。今早出大宅前我跟她说的正是这话。

lines.en: : Mother! Please!
lines.zh: : 母亲！求您了！

lines.en: : The same goes for you as well, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 你也是一样，Tsubasa。

lines.en: scene toukatrain8
: Hm? I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你说什么？

lines.en: : Just a little overdressed for the occasion is all. Us “commoners” don’t normally wear our family crests on our necks.
lines.zh: : 只是这场合穿得有点太隆重了。我们「平民」一般不把自己家族的家徽挂在脖子上。

lines.en: We also don’t wear shirts that look like they’re going to come unbuttoned at any moment for the most part, but I guess that ones a sort of case by case basis.
lines.zh: 我们也大多不穿那种「随时可能崩开扣子」的衬衫——不过这条大概得视情况而定。

lines.en: : But I...can’t simply leave the crest at home like Touka and Tsukasa do. Not as the wife of the Tsukioka Foundation’s chairman. It must remain on my person at all times.
lines.zh: : 可我……没法像 Touka 和 Tsukasa 那样把家徽留在家里。我可是月冈财团会长的夫人。它必须时刻戴在我身上。

lines.en: : Father wouldn’t know if you took it off for a day out on the town, Mother.
lines.zh: : 母亲，您出来逛一天的话，父亲不会知道您把它摘了。

lines.en: scene toukatrain9
: Touka, please. This isn’t like a wedding ring. I can’t just...take it off whenever I want.
lines.zh: : Touka，别这样。这又不是婚戒。我不能……想摘就摘。

lines.en: : Do you...really not have anything planned, Sensei? Because I’d feel rather embarrassed to have brought my family along for...absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 你……真的什么都没安排吗，Sensei？因为要是把我家人都拉来却……一无所获，我会很难堪。

lines.en: : Not to mention getting dressed for the occasion- even if it’s not quite up to par with what you’d expect someone closer to your...level of income to be wearing.
lines.zh: : 更别说我们还特意打扮了一番——尽管不太符合你对「收入接近你那个水平的人」的穿着预期。

lines.en: : I really don’t. So if the three of you want to go back home and-
lines.zh: : 我真没安排。所以你们三位要是想回家——

lines.en: : I have an idea!
lines.zh: : 我有个主意！

lines.en: scene toukatrain10
: Tsukasa, {i}please{/i} tell me it doesn’t involve a kitchen.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，{i}求{/i}你告诉我跟厨房无关。

lines.en: : It...probably doesn’t?! I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 大概……无关？！我不知道！

lines.en: : What’s your idea, Tsurumi?
lines.zh: : 你的主意是什么，Tsurumi？

lines.en: : My name isn’t-
lines.zh: : 我不叫——

lines.en: : He has a memory problem, Tsukasa. Just accept it.
lines.zh: : 他记性不好，Tsukasa。你就认了吧。

lines.en: : Fine! Okay!
lines.zh: : 行！好吧！

lines.en: : I, Tsurumi Tsukioka, demand that you take us to the thing called a “subway!”
lines.zh: : 我，Tsurumi Tsukioka，命令你带我们去坐那个叫「地铁」的东西！

lines.en: : You don’t have to accept the name, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 你不用认下这个名字，Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Why is adult life so confusing?!
lines.zh: : 大人的世界怎么这么让人费解？！

lines.en: : Tsukasa, dear. Why do you want to see the subway exactly? This was supposed to be a tour of...various summer related activities.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，亲爱的。你为什么想看地铁？这本该是一场……各种夏日活动的游览。

lines.en: scene toukatrain11
: Because it’s the first thing that comes to mind when I think of people who have less money than us!
lines.zh: : 因为我一想到「比我们钱少的人」，脑子里第一个蹦出来的就是它！

lines.en: : What screams “poor people” louder than a bunch of sweaty commoners paying money to get  crammed into a rectangular metal box underground?
lines.zh: : 还有什么比「一群汗流浃背的平民花钱挤进地下的长方形金属盒」更响亮地喊出「穷人」的？

lines.en: : I...suppose that is a fair point?
lines.zh: : 我……想这话有点道理？

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Is the subway...you know...{i}safe,{/i} Sensei? Because it’s come up in several of the instructional videos I’ve watched at home about safety.
lines.zh: : 地铁……那个……{i}安全{/i}吗，Sensei？因为我在家看的几支「安全教学视频」里提到过它。

lines.en: scene toukatrain12
: Touka raises a good question- {i}is{/i} the subway safe? Because I remember gropers being a bit of a problem when I was Touka’s age.
lines.zh: : Touka 问得好——地铁{i}安全{/i}吗？因为我记得，我在 Touka 这个年纪时，「痴汉」还挺成问题的。

lines.en: : What’s a groper?
lines.zh: : 什么是痴汉？

lines.en: : A thing that very likely doesn’t exist around here anymore on account of the severe drought in testosterone.
lines.zh: : 一种在这附近多半已经绝迹的东西——因为这儿的睾酮严重枯竭。

lines.en: : What is testosterone? A food?
lines.zh: : 什么是睾酮？一种食物吗？

lines.en: : The subway should be fine. I just don’t ever really ride it since there’s not much of a need, though.
lines.zh: : 地铁应该没问题。不过我平时基本不坐，因为没什么必要。

lines.en: : I also don’t think it will be very fun, but who am I to tell anyone how to have a good time when one of Touka’s key interests is horses?
lines.zh: : 而且我也不觉得会有多好玩——不过，Touka 的主要兴趣之一是马，我又有什么资格教别人怎么找乐子呢。

lines.en: scene toukatrain13

: I’m sorry, do you have an issue with {i}horses{/i} now? Because, last I checked, they were majestic, smart creatures who have been serving us longer than nearly any other animal for nothing in return.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你现在是对{i}马{/i}有意见了？据我所知，马是高贵又聪明的生灵，为我们服务的年头比几乎任何动物都长，还分文不取。

lines.en: : Yeah, hearing all that gives me hope that you guys might like the subway after all.
lines.zh: : 是啊，听你这么一说，我倒是有了点信心，觉得你们说不定会喜欢地铁。

lines.en: : I don’t...ugh.
lines.zh: : 我不……唉。

lines.en: : Forget it.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: : Well...I suppose it’s better than nothing. Seeing how the layman moves from place to place could be a wonderful, educational experience for my daughters.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……我想总比没有强。看看普通人怎么从一处挪到另一处，对我两个女儿来说会是段极好的、有教育意义的经历。

lines.en: : I suppose there’s just the matter of figuring out where to ride the subway {i}to.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那剩下的问题就是，该坐地铁去{i}哪儿{/i}了。

lines.en: : We’d have to figure that out when we go down to the station. Like I said, I don’t ride it very often, so I have no idea where it even leads.
lines.zh: : 那得等我们下到车站再定。我说了，我不常坐，所以根本不知道它通哪儿。

lines.en: scene toukatrain14
: Never fear, teacher man! I used my {i}smartphone{/i} this morning to memorize the route map for each individual train!
lines.zh: : 别慌，老师先生！我今早已经用我的{i}智能手机{/i}，把每一条线路的路线图都背下来了！

lines.en: : Do you know what a smartphone is? Or are you too poor to-
lines.zh: : 你知道什么是智能手机吗？还是你穷到——

lines.en: : I have a smartphone, Tsurumi. They’re accessible to {i}my people{/i} now.
lines.zh: : 我有智能手机，Tsurumi。{i}我们这种人{/i}现在也用得起了。

lines.en: : Also, there is no way you memorized the route map for every train.
lines.zh: : 另外，你不可能把每条线路的路线图都背下来。

lines.en: : Oh, I wouldn’t put that past her. Tsukasa might be a handful, but she’s actually quite the little genius for her age. Her memory is near photographic as well.
lines.zh: : 哦，这事她干得出来。Tsukasa 虽然难带，但以她的年纪，她其实是个小天才。记忆力也近乎过目不忘。

lines.en: : If you’ve wanted to ride the subway that badly, why haven’t you asked Father to simply build us one under the manor? He’s talked about it in the past as a means for staff members to get around.
lines.zh: : 你要这么想坐地铁，干嘛不干脆让父亲在大宅底下给我们建一条？他以前提过这个，说是方便佣人通行。

lines.en: scene toukatrain15
: It wouldn’t be the same! There are no poor people at our house! And everyone is constantly speaking in different languages that only Mother understands!
lines.zh: : 那不一样！我们家没有穷人！而且所有人都一直用只有母亲听得懂的各种语言说话！

lines.en: : Well...as long as Sensei is okay with it...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……只要 Sensei 没意见……

lines.en: scene toukatrain16
: But if you get lost, we’re not coming back for you. You’re going to have to find a new family.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是走丢了，我们可不会回来找你。你得另找个家了。

lines.en: : Mother! Touka is being mean to me!
lines.zh: : 母亲！Touka 欺负我！

lines.en: : Is the station far from here, Sensei? Should I wave down a taxi or summon us a limo?
lines.zh: : 车站离这儿远吗，Sensei？我该挥手叫出租车，还是召一辆豪车？

lines.en: : Have you really been cooped up in that manor for so long that you think taxis are just driving around suburban areas looking for passengers?
lines.zh: : 你真在那座宅子里关到以为出租车会在郊区兜圈找客人吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Oh.
: Well, they’re not.
lines.zh: : 好吧，并不会。

lines.en: : The station is literally right behind you, though. We can be there in less than five minutes if we want.
lines.zh: : 不过车站就在你正后方。我们愿意的话，五分钟都用不了就到。

lines.en: scene toukatrain17
: That’s it?!
lines.zh: : 就这？！

lines.en: : What are we waiting for then?!
lines.zh: : 那我们还在等什么？！

lines.en: : Take us to the peasant version of a sardine can already, Mr. Teacher!
lines.zh: : 快带我们去平民版「沙丁鱼罐头」啦，老师先生！

lines.en: scene black
I gesture toward the station behind the Tsukiokas and begin to make my way over, only to be followed closely behind by them like they’re a pack of high class escorts.
lines.zh: 我朝月冈家母女身后的车站示意，开始走过去——她们紧随其后，像一队高级伴游。

lines.en: Well, two of them at least.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少是两个。

lines.en: Or one.
lines.zh: 或者一个。

lines.en: I’m followed closely behind by three girls who look nothing like me.
lines.zh: 我被三个长得跟我一点都不像的女孩紧紧跟着。

lines.en: Which is...probably nowhere even close to my initial perception of what the sight appears to be.
lines.zh: 这画面……跟我起初以为「会是什么样」大概差了十万八千里。

lines.en: Anyway. Subway station.
lines.zh: 总之，地铁站到了。

lines.en: scene toukatrain18
: This way, Mother! Follow the scent of standing water and processed meats!
lines.zh: : 这边走，母亲！跟着积水和加工肉制品的味道走！

lines.en: : Tsukasa, dear, are you sure this is the right way? It’s been a long time, but I think we may have to visit a ticket kiosk of some sort first.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，亲爱的，你确定走对了吗？隔了这么久，我好像记得我们得先去个什么售票亭。

lines.en: : I’m...sorry I dragged them along, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我……很抱歉把她们也拖来了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Well, I suppose it was less of me {i}dragging{/i} them and more of them simply latching onto my dress and seeing where it leads.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，与其说是我把她们{i}拖{/i}来的，不如说是她们拽着我的裙子、看它把我带向哪儿。

lines.en: : It’s a nice dress.
lines.zh: : 这条裙子很好看。

lines.en: : Is that how you really feel? Or are you just saying that because it’s currently a three-for-one deal?
lines.zh: : 你是真心这么觉得？还是因为现在是「三送一」，你才这么说的？

lines.en: : That’s how I really feel. It fits you well.
lines.zh: : 我是真心的。它很衬你。

lines.en: : Well...thank you, Sensei. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……谢谢你，Sensei。我很感激。

lines.en: : Like, {i}really{/i} well.
lines.zh: : {i}真的特别{/i}衬。

lines.en: : And there you go, ruining yet another moment where I believed you to be a good man for a fraction of a second.
lines.zh: : 瞧瞧，你又毁掉了一个我「有那么零点几秒以为你是个好人」的时刻。

lines.en: scene black
Tsukasa, who somehow managed to get in front of all of us (Likely due to her difference in size), leads the way to a random train that, at least I {i}hope{/i} she’s actually memorized the path of.
lines.zh: Tsukasa 不知怎么走到了我们所有人前头（多半因为她个子小），带头走向一趟随机的列车——{i}但愿{/i}她真把路线背下来了。

lines.en: All things considered, there are a few areas of this city I don’t really see fit for the Tsukioka family just yet.
lines.zh: 总的来说，这座城里有几个地方，我暂时还不太想让月冈家的人涉足。

lines.en: Sure, Touka was able to survive a trip to the Old District, but if anything like what happened with Yumi and I were to happen in front of an entire family- let alone one as influential as this...
lines.zh: 是，Touka 活着从老城区回来了，可要是「我和 Yumi 之间那种事」当着一整个家族的面重演——何况是这么有影响力的家族……

lines.en: Well, let’s just say Ami might never see me again.
lines.zh: 这么说吧，Ami 可能就再也见不到我了。

lines.en: Or anyone for that matter.
lines.zh: 谁都见不着。

lines.en: So...yeah.
lines.zh: 所以……是啊。

lines.en: Here’s hoping the train stops somewhere other than impending doom and tragedy.
lines.zh: 但愿这趟车停靠的地方，不是「近在咫尺的厄运与悲剧」。

lines.en: scene toukatrain19
We make our way into a subway car and, contrary to Tsukasa’s description from earlier, it’s not like we’re being packed in at all.
lines.zh: 我们走进一节地铁车厢，跟 Tsukasa 先前的描述相反，我们压根没被「挤」进去。

lines.en: I’m sure that roughly half of the population no longer being around has something to do with that, but I’m not about to complain about an actual convenience when I understand how bad it could have been.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定这跟「大约一半的人口不在了」有关——不过既然我清楚情况本可以糟得多，这种实打实的便利我就不抱怨了。

lines.en: : Does it always smell this...{i}horrible{/i} in here?
lines.zh: : 这儿一直都这么……{i}难闻{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Hi. I’m Tsurumi Tsukioka, a poor person just like you. But you can probably tell on account of my shirt.
lines.zh: : 你好。我是 Tsurumi Tsukioka，跟你一样的穷人。不过你多半从我这件 T 恤就看出来了。

lines.en: : Tsuka- ahem.
lines.zh: : Tsuka——咳。

lines.en: : Tsurumi dear, please don’t pester the other passengers.
lines.zh: : Tsurumi 亲爱的，请别打扰其他乘客。

lines.en: : What is your favorite commoner activity? Mine is watching the news.
lines.zh: : 你最喜欢的平民活动是什么？我最喜欢的是看新闻。

lines.en: : {i}Tsurumi,{/i} that woman is asleep. Please do not wake her up.
lines.zh: : {i}Tsurumi{/i}，那位女士睡着了。请别吵醒她。

lines.en: scene toukatrain20
: So, what do we do now? Are there any...private compartments for groups of three or more?
lines.zh: : 那，我们现在干嘛？有没有……供三人以上团体使用的「私人包间」？

lines.en: : I don’t believe that sort of thing is available on subways, dear. From what I understand, this is a form of local transport used to get from one place to another in a quick, uncomplicated manner.
lines.zh: : 我想地铁上没有那种东西，亲爱的。据我所知，这是一种本地交通工具，用来快速、省事地从一处到另一处。

lines.en: : So...we all just...stand in this small space together until we get to our destination? Is there a...gift shop? Or a...restroom, even?
lines.zh: : 所以……我们就只能……一起挤在这个小空间里直到到站？有没有……纪念品商店？或者哪怕……洗手间？

lines.en: : Nope. Just other duplicates of this exact subway car, all chained together in typical poor person fashion.
lines.zh: : 没有。只有一节节一模一样的车厢，以典型的穷人方式串在一起。

lines.en: scene toukatrain21
: Okay, Mother. I’m over this. It looked more fun on the Internet and all of these people look really sad.
lines.zh: : 好了，母亲。我受够了。在网上看着比这好玩多了，而且这些人看着都好丧。

lines.en: : Well, I assume that’s because they are.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我猜那是因为他们确实很丧。

lines.en: : Also, we can’t leave just yet dear. The train has just started moving.
lines.zh: : 另外，我们现在还不能下车，亲爱的。车刚开动。

lines.en: scene toukatrain22
: Well, then ask them to stop! This is boring!
lines.zh: : 那就让他们停车！这好无聊！

lines.en: : It doesn’t work that way, dear. I think. I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 不是这样的，亲爱的。好像是。我其实也不太确定。

lines.en: : You’re right. It doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。不是那样的。

lines.en: : Exactly. It doesn’t work that way, dear.
lines.zh: : 正是。不是这样的，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, this was {i}your{/i} idea. And, pardon the pun, but...you have to ride it out to the end.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，这可是{i}你{/i}提的主意。而且，原谅我用个双关——你得「一路坐到底」。

lines.en: : Nice pun.
lines.zh: : 双关不错。

lines.en: : I said pardon it, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我说了请原谅它，Sensei。

lines.en: : I don’t have to do anything! {i}We{/i} don’t have to do anything! We’re rich! We probably own this stupid subway car!
lines.zh: : 我想怎样就怎样！{i}我们{/i}想怎样就怎样！我们有钱！这破地铁车厢多半都是我们家的！

lines.en: : Not yet. But give it a few years, sweetie. Who knows what your father’s next big plan will be?
lines.zh: : 现在还不是。不过再等几年，宝贝。谁知道你父亲下一步的大计划是什么？

lines.en: scene toukatrain23
: Are we allowed to sit down on this subway thing? Or do we need to pay extra for that?
lines.zh: : 我们可以在这「地铁」上坐下吗？还是那得另外加钱？

lines.en: : You need to pay extra. There are doors connecting the cars. Take the ones on your left all the way to the end and ask the person in the room at the head of the train for permission and a seating ticket.
lines.zh: : 得另外加钱。车厢之间有门相通。走你左手边的那些，一直走到头，向车头那间屋里的人申请许可和「座位票」。

lines.en: scene toukatrain24
: Oh! I believe I’ve heard of that person before. The...conductor, I think?
lines.zh: : 哦！我好像听过那个人。那个……「列车长」，对吧？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Was that always a rule?...
lines.zh: : 一直都有这条规矩吗？……

lines.en: : As a special thanks for your assistance, I’ll be sure to purchase you a seat as well, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 作为对你帮忙的特别感谢，我也会给你买一个座位的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Thanks, Touka. If you could also get me a drink from the cooler in the conductor’s room, it would be greatly appreciated as well. They’re complimentary, so you won’t have to pay.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Touka。你要是能顺便从列车长房间的冷藏柜里给我拿瓶饮料，我也很感激。那些是免费的，你就不用付钱了。

lines.en: : Of course. Does green tea sound okay?
lines.zh: : 当然。绿茶可以吗？

lines.en: : Perfect, actually. Thanks, Touka.
lines.zh: : 其实正合适。谢了，Touka。

lines.en: : My pleasure.
lines.zh: : 我的荣幸。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Five minutes later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}五分钟后……{/i}

lines.en: scene toukatrain25
: Oh {i}good.{/i} You managed to sit down without your {i}seating ticket.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}好{/i}。你居然没拿{i}「座位票」{/i}就坐下了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I forgot they aren’t needed on the weekends. My bad.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我忘了周末不需要票。怪我。

lines.en: : Does tormenting me truly cause you enough joy to warrant continuously doing it? Do you not get bored of having me make a fool of myself?
lines.zh: : 折磨我真的能给你带来足够的快乐，以至于你一直这么干？你让我出丑，你就不会腻吗？

lines.en: : It does and not really.
lines.zh: : 会，而且不怎么腻。

lines.en: scene toukatrain26
: Hah...Well, I suppose it’s over now. All there is left to do is ride this train until Tsukasa decides it’s time to get off.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧，我想这事算过去了。剩下的就只有坐着这趟车，直到 Tsukasa 说该下了。

lines.en: : Pretty sure that will be the next station. She doesn’t seem as thrilled as she expected to be among her beloved poor people.
lines.zh: : 我很确定那就是下一站。她在她「心爱的穷人」堆里，好像没她以为的那么兴奋。

lines.en: : Yes, but did you truly expect her to be? She’s even more spoiled than I am and I have a helicopter with my name painted on it.
lines.zh: : 是，可你真以为她会吗？她比我还被惯坏了——而我可是有一架喷着我名字的直升机的。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : It was a present for my tenth birthday.
lines.zh: : 那是我十岁的生日礼物。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene toukatrain27
: Why do you think, Sensei? Because I’m lucky...and happened to be born into a family that had already carved out a sizable part of this world.
lines.zh: : 你说为什么，Sensei？因为我走运……恰好生在一个已经在这世上占下一席之地的家庭。

lines.en: : I have many things that others could only dream of due to no hard work or...work {i}at all{/i} on my own.
lines.zh: : 我拥有许多别人只能梦想的东西，而这跟我自己的努力或……{i}任何{/i}努力都毫无关系。

lines.en: scene toukatrain28
: I’m a [teenage]girl on the cusp of becoming a woman and I don’t even know how to ride the subway or...what the other girls in my class do to celebrate their summer vacations.
lines.zh: : 我是个[十几岁]的女孩，眼看就要成为女人，却连地铁都不会坐，也……不知道班上其他女孩暑假都怎么庆祝。

lines.en: : I’m entirely hopeless when torn out of my element.
lines.zh: : 一旦被拽出我的「主场」，我就彻底没辙。

lines.en: : And yet all you do is toy with me.
lines.zh: : 而你呢，就只会捉弄我。

lines.en: : Sorry. Did you say something? I wasn’t paying attention.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你刚才说什么了吗？我没在听。

lines.en: scene toukatrain29
: Rude. I was attempting to have a moment with you.
lines.zh: : 无礼。我刚才还想跟你「共渡一刻」呢。

lines.en: : I don’t normally “have moments” with girls when their mothers are sitting directly beside them.
lines.zh: : 女孩的母亲就坐在正旁边时，我一般不跟她们「共渡一刻」。

lines.en: : Well I apologize for being the bearer of bad news, but my mother is a very big part of my life.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我要泼你冷水，但我母亲是我人生里非常大的一部分。

lines.en: : And if you and I are going to continue spending time with one another, I can only hope that {i}she’ll{/i} have the time to be there for some of it.
lines.zh: : 而且，要是你我还想继续相处下去，我只能希望{i}她{/i}也有空参与我们的一部分时光。

lines.en: : It’s just something you’ll have to accept. Like how {i}I’ve{/i} accepted you’re a tasteless hack who couldn’t tell a salad fork from a soup spoon.
lines.zh: : 这是你必须接受的事。就像{i}我{/i}已经接受了「你是个没品位的骗子，连沙拉叉和汤匙都分不清」。

lines.en: : Is the spoon the pointy one? My small, proletarian brain can’t quite remember.
lines.zh: : 汤匙是尖的那个吗？我这颗小小的无产阶级脑袋记不太清。

lines.en: scene toukatrain30
: Mhm! So the next time the maître d’ asks you if you’re missing anything and you notice a distinct lack of pointed utensils, make sure to ask for a new spoon.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！所以下次侍者领班问你还缺什么、而你发现餐具里缺了「尖的」，记得要一把新汤匙。

lines.en: : You have a long way to go if you’re trying to trick me into doing the same sorts of things I trick {i}you{/i} into.
lines.zh: : 你要想骗我做「我骗{i}你{/i}做的那些事」，还差得远呢。

lines.en: : Maybe for now.
lines.zh: : 也许眼下是。

lines.en: : But that’s just because I’m still out of my element.
lines.zh: : 但那只是因为我还「不在主场」。

lines.en: : You just wait until I drag you into {i}my{/i} lifestyle. We’ll see who truly struggles to adapt then.
lines.zh: : 你就等着我把你拖进{i}我的{/i}生活方式吧。到时候再看谁才真正「水土不服」。

lines.en: : I didn’t really think you intended on dragging me into your lifestyle anytime soon, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我可没觉得你短期内打算把我拖进你的生活方式，Touka。

lines.en: : Neither did I. But the thought of seeing you suffer sounds a little too good to overlook anymore.
lines.zh: : 我也没有。不过一想到看你受罪，那画面就好到让我没法再忽视了。

lines.en: scene toukatrain31
: Well, it’s a weird sentence to say, but I guess I’m looking a little forward to whatever suffering you have in store for me.
lines.zh: : 这话听着是怪，但我想我有点期待你为我准备的那份「受罪」了。

lines.en: : As am I...
lines.zh: : 我也是……

lines.en: : You called me Touka again.
lines.zh: : 你刚才又叫我 Touka 了。

lines.en: scene black
$ touka_love += 1
$ toukaspecial15 = True
{i}Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度提升到了 [touka_love]!{/i}

lines.en: We ride the subway to the end of the line after Tsukasa takes Touka’s earlier comment of “riding things out” to heart and wind up at a station that looks significantly different from the one we boarded from.
lines.zh: Tsukasa 把 Touka 先前那句「一路坐到底」听了进去，我们坐地铁一直坐到终点站，最后在一个跟上车站看起来大不相同的车站下了车。

lines.en: Wanting to stretch their legs and observe wherever it is we’ve wound up, the female members of the Tsukioka family exit the subway car and, after awkwardly looking around the station, head for a nearby staircase.
lines.zh: 月冈家的女眷们想活动活动腿脚、看看我们到底到了哪儿，于是走出车厢，在车站里别扭地四下张望后，朝附近一段楼梯走去。

lines.en: Once we get to the top, however, and a flood of multicolored light overtakes us- they realize just how out of place they are in this world.
lines.zh: 可等我们爬到顶上、一片五彩斑斓的光迎面扑来时——她们才意识到，自己在这个世界上有多么格格不入。

lines.en: jump toukaspecial15p2
